guitar.modelsText: Turner Model 1 (Buckingham) / 1959 Gibson Les Paul "Greeny" (Peter Green)
guitar.evidence: Peter Green's 1959 Les Paul ('Greeny', later owned by Gary Moore/Kirk Hammett) is extremely famous; Lindsey Buckingham's Rick Turner Model 1 is also well documented as his main stage guitar from the late 70s onward.
guitar.notes: Upgraded from medium to high given how well documented both instruments are.

tone.target: bright jangly clean-crunch with slight compression
tone.profile: bright jangly clean-crunch with slight compression
tone.summary: A classic clean signal chain utilizing a Boost/Comp for initial tone shaping, followed by a Fender-style amp (US Deluxe) and a 2x12 cab, enhanced with Chorus and Spring Reverb to achieve the bright, jangly sound of Fleetwood Mac.

rig.name: Fleetwood Mac - Don't Stop - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide light compression and sustain for tight strumming.
Add the required clean-crunch edge without heavy distortion.
Simulate the bright, clean Fender-style amp tone.
Provide the open-back, bright cabinet sound.
Add the characteristic 'jangly' shimmer and movement.
Enhance bright upper mids and overall clarity.
Provide subtle, classic reverb as suggested by the gear clues.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to enhance the jangly, bright clean-crunch character.

proposals.reason: Enhance open-back clarity and vintage sparkle for jangle tone.
